architecture.forward_API: MarkerResolutionReadoutV1(H044BoundMarkerBankV1, flags=...); bundle from exact one-time CPU bind_marker_bank_v1
architecture.head_checkpointing: Exact nonreentrant activation checkpointing in fixed query/center chunks; no temporal truncation.
architecture.matched_initialization: make_matched_pair_v1 deep-copies the complete loaded H042+decoder state, then uses independent arms/optimizers.
architecture.new_decoder: shared classwise Linear38to16(bias),SiLU,Linear16to1(no bias),zero final projection

corrections_before_admission: Categorical Jeffreys0.5 per supplied original allele cardinality, or explicitly all observed panel allele support; retain valid allele2/3. Binary is Bernoulli.
Separate exact ordered/hash-bound physical SNP-position sidecar; frozen original bank/source untouched.
Frozen backbone means source/architecture; both arms fine-tune every H042 weight plus same new decoder.
Original100bp target_mass for both arms; never native_hold_train_mass. Stream or bounded-LRU one complete parent mass shared by both arms.
Dense-grid all96VAL seals require21,073,920,000bytes max; proposed32,000,000,000byte prediction cap, root admission required.
Query columns are selected once before gathering scoring-center holds, preserving gradients while avoiding all952-leaf readout transients.
Evidence prefix/window arithmetic uses CPU FP64 bookkeeping; counts and emitted features remainFP32 and all learning/gradients remainFP32.
Actual original CPU bank marker identities are verified once; immutable bank/marker objects and storage/version stamps travel through typed device transfer. Shape-only forward acceptance is removed.

evidence.boxes: closed [center-radius,center+radius], clipped by actually observed coverage; no extrapolation/imputation
evidence.complexity: Fixed-four-allele counts O(S*H*C), one-time O(P*R*logS) searchsorted, all query prefix/window/pooled work O(S*Q*C+P*Q*C*R) with R3,C4 fixed. No pairwise affinity or per-marker Python recurrence.
evidence.model_channels: three averages and three log1p effective counts per class
evidence.per_window: average over markers with called query and at least one called class reference, countzero -> averagezero
evidence.pooled_control: Physical-bin-width mean of exact six features over centers with the same original readout_hold; only scored holds allocated. No native tree is removed from backbone.

memory.GPU_residency: Separate actual cap; backbone/autograd/runtime allocator peak unmeasured.
memory.feature_cache: Bounded byte-accounted LRU proposed32–48GB, actual S/H/dtypes counted including borrowed storage; admission unresolved.
memory.prefix_bytes: 12*(S+1)*query_block*C for FP64 evidence prefix +FP32 count prefix
memory.readout_transients: Named tensor bounds are not total allocator/autograd peaks; include complete original body, output concatenation, prefix/gather and pooling temporaries separately under actual admission.
memory.retained_marker_tensors: genotype_bytes*S*H +76*S+76*P+8*Q (including borrowed genotype, fixed window index pairs and scored-hold pool inverse)

motivation.prior_H038_boundary_geometry: About27.3percent of true diagnostic boundaries have no nearby allowed hold edge; motivates testing resolution rather than asserting mechanism.

novelty: No novelty claim for categorical emissions, pseudocounts, prefix sums, box filters or residual readout. Test empirical intra-tree localization under matched source/features/parameters/budget; literature novelty requires separate assessment.
required_original_bank_fields: all original H042 whole-tree/PyG/GRU bank fields

training.VAL_predictions_before_truth: All2arms x6passes x8parents dense immutable100bp probability seals before anyVAL truth.
training.target: Original exact physical per-bin class span mass[P,686,4], shared for both arms; per-parent NLL=sum(-mass*logsoftmax)/sum(mass)
